subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should `inbound_claim` run for ordinary Feishu/channel inbound messages, or remain limited to plugin-owned conversation bindings?
rationale: The source-visible gap is real, but changing `inbound_claim` from targeted plugin-owned routing to general first-claim-wins inbound routing can change plugin ownership, command handling, and safety behavior.

options.title: General inbound_claim with guardrails
options.body: Make normal inbound messages claimable before agent routing, with tests that preserve command authorization, message_received observers, and no double delivery.

options.title: Plugin-owned only
options.body: Keep `inbound_claim` targeted to plugin-owned bindings and update public docs to stop implying passive global claim support.

options.title: Split the hooks
options.body: Add a separate passive observer or pre-routing hook for Feishu-style listeners while preserving `inbound_claim` ownership semantics.

recommendation.title: General inbound_claim with guardrails
recommendation.body: Make normal inbound messages claimable before agent routing, with tests that preserve command authorization, message_received observers, and no double delivery.
